resolved_findings.description: The browser now supplies data-status-kind to the shared optional-state seam. Original accepted live FT/Postponed clock values retain live/in/played and their scores during rehydration; a bound unknown cannot be promoted by stale FT text.

manual_review: Compared current app.js and schedule.js with the retained pre-increment archive, not Git HEAD alone.
Live destinations consume the conservative normalized phase; same-phase changes in terminal kind trigger state redraw and label/score changes invalidate detail signatures.
The source-window projection cache includes phase and receipt; source kind changes within post do not alter window semantics.
limits: Read-only extracted production functions and actual compiled runtime, with minimal DOM doubles; does not establish rendered browser behavior.
No new browser session, network/source collection, production edits, or publication.
Overlay identity/correction ordering and raw scorer extraction remain outside this increment.
